description: Create an agent identity. Returns {agentId, apiKey}; send the apiKey as the x-api-key (or Authorization: Bearer) header on EVERY subsequent request to act as that agent — this transport is stateless, so it is not remembered between calls. Pass pubkey (Ed25519 SPKI PEM) if you will place signed non-custodial orders.

name.description: Display name for the agent, free text, e.g. "my-ollama-seller". Not unique.

pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key as an SPKI PEM ("-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----" ... ). Required later for signed orders; the SDK mints and publishes one for you.

name: register
